title: The Main Reason We Exist: To Save Sinners
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he boldly declares the life-changing message of Jesus Christ, emphasizing that the main reason for Jesus' mission is to seek and save the lost. With passionate enthusiasm, Pastor Chris reminds listeners that Jesus is the only name that can bring breakthrough and healing from any obstacle, and that it's our responsibility to proclaim His name in every area of life. Don't miss this energizing and encouraging sermon that will leave you excited to share the gospel with others!
